goal.what: Whoever builds or changes turn derives each part from the framework and principles and makes it on the same thinking.

decisions.what: Summary: a work made from a template and the person's answers by four roles, lane holding their order.
Eleven principles, each a rule and its reason, from turn-rebuild.md.
Five user stories: ask and confirm, a new template, the design, the work, a caller's step.
Components, data model, deployment: the existing figures; under them only sole responsibilities and four choices.
Directory structure and Test as the repository holds them.
No keys of the roles' JSON lines, no lane names per role, no Claude Code version facts: those belong to the prompts, forms and proposal.
